allowed_market_description: Identifiable topical relation to at least one enabled canonical asset, including performance observations, education and opinions. No directional thesis or economic exposure is required.
equity_macro_description: Explicit equity-market macro discussion maps to the enabled equity universe through curated relation definitions. Every story requires a nonempty enabled asset set.

rules.instruction: Require retained evidence for a direct identity or curated topical relation; never rescue an unmapped company using sector peers.
Reject evidenced material changes to identity, numbers, negation, attribution or meaning; harmless ASR differences are diagnostics.
Retain decodable final media, valid intervals, caption geometry and hash-bound immutable evidence.
